summary: The GenericDocument is a part of a system used to manage documents related to agencies, sites, and other entities within an HSPnet session. It includes functionalities to sort, manage, and access these documents, and integrates with a database for data retrieval and manipulation.
purpose: The purpose of GenericDocument is to handle various document-related operations such as retrieval, sorting, validation, and linking within the HSPnet system, which supports healthcare placement networks.

fields.name: ParentID
fields.description: Identifier for the parent entity of the document.

fields.name: TypeCodeID
fields.description: Identifier for the type of document.

fields.name: TypeComments
fields.description: Comments associated with the document type.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: File path of the document in the system.

fields.name: UpdateDate
fields.description: Last update date of the document.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: Identifier of the user who last updated the document.

fields.name: IsApplied
fields.description: Indicates if the document has been applied.

fields.name: SourceLevel
fields.description: Source level indication for the document.

fields.name: CanEditRow
fields.description: Indicates if the document row can be edited.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.role: Represents a session of the HSPnet system within which documents are managed.

workflows.name: Document Retrieval
steps: Apply sorting based on specified parameters.

business_rules: Documents must have a valid type and name.
Documents linked to specific agencies or sites must adhere to their respective sort orders.
validations: Document type and name are mandatory.
File URL must not be blank if the document ID is specified.
conditions: Check if the document is of type 'document' by verifying if the FilePath is not empty.
Translate file type using localization settings.
system_behavior: Documents are fetched via stored procedures using specified parameters.
Documents are sorted based on source levels and specified criteria.
Documents can be linked and displayed with specific formatting if they are applied.
dependencies: Database connection for data retrieval and manipulation.
Localization resources for translating file types and other strings.
exceptions: If document fields are not valid, an error is added to the session messages.
